column1: # Original native GCC, binutils, musl headers/crt/libc, no guest package fetch

column3: sh -c 'cd /tmp && echo M38_COMPILER_START && /usr/bin/gcc --version && /usr/bin/gcc -static /tests/hello.c -o hello && echo M38_LINKED && /bin/busybox ls -l /tmp && /bin/busybox stat /tmp/hello && /bin/busybox chmod 755 hello && ./hello && /usr/bin/gcc -static /tests/readv.c -o readv && ./readv'
